subject: general
question:
Which of the following options will be the most approximate value that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

259.99 ÷ 24.99 × 35.01 - 29.98 × 9.96 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

259.99 ÷ 24.99 × 35.01 - 29.98 × 9.96 = ?

**Concept used:**

BODMAS rule

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/ZFoN-bAYshcZXA6Vkb6XBLuz3naCK2rCjL9VNMK5FBoQapzj_is-liVAq5wqRuaXx_QymC0xNQlXx7prnKQctl99GyCLVZRb4PniOSpj0WPQD11CQfzEtxz31CDKdXI4Y2NPzj1Xxxn5xaAeyPnKzvQ] 

**Calculation:** 

[(260 ÷ 25) × 35] - (30 × 10) 

⇒ [10.4 × 35] - (300) 

⇒ 364 - 300 = 64. 

**∴ The most approximate value of the given equation is 64. **
